mechanization.result_line: Query event(accepted_at_B(t, e_v)) ==> event(issued_at_A(t, e_i)) /\ e_v == e_i is true.

hedge.narrows: Verifiers must retain a sparse log of historical federation roots; storage cost O(log epoch + recent-window). See §fh-A.3 storage bound (pinned this round).

refuses: unbound tokens (any token without an epoch field is rejected by the verifier).
prices: retention of the historical federation root log (operators who keep deeper history charge more, or are paid more, depending on the federation pricing rule).

preempt_analogy.differentiator: FH adds cross-harbor epoch-binding. Macaroons attenuate along a chain but do not bind epoch — re-presentation of a revoked Macaroon depends on out-of-band revocation. FH binds epoch into the preimage and pins the verifier to the historical root.
